title: Mushroom pan sauce poultry seasoning chicken with broccolini
ingredients: Pan sear chicken with poultry seasoning, maybe some fresh thyme and rosemary and sage. Bake brocollini with salt and pepper olive oil.
Make pan sauce with fried mushrooms, corn starch, white wine, chicken broth (optional), corn starch.
